title: Relief Grooves for Grinding Zones and Thread
topics: Dimensional specifications for relief grooves by size range
rules: Relief grooves for thread must be made in case where the thread zone ends at a shoulder with ledge function
Relief groove geometry must comply with UNI regulation or TRASMITAL specifications
Groove dimensions vary by diameter range: 18-50mm, 51-80mm, 81-125mm, >125mm
Possible specific grooves must be indicated in details in drawing
Thread relief groove pitch (P) determines groove dimensions R, A, B, T1, T2
dimensions: Grinding relief 18-50mm: width 2.5mm, depth 0.1mm, radius R 1...R 1.6, angle 30°
Grinding relief 51-80mm: width 3mm, depth 0.2mm, radius R 1.6...R 1.6, angle 30°
Grinding relief 81-125mm: width 4.5mm, depth 0.3mm, radius R 2.5, angle 30°
Grinding relief >125mm: width 7mm, depth varies, radius R4.0, angle 30°
tolerances: Grinding relief >125mm: width tolerance ±0.2mm (with B tolerance), depth varies ±0.3mm
inspection: Verify relief groove dimensions according to diameter or pitch range
Check groove position relative to shoulder or thread termination
Confirm groove geometry matches UNI4386 or TRASMITAL specifications
Verify specific grooves are detailed in drawing when non-standard
manufacturing_notes: Relief grooves facilitate grinding operations by providing clearance
Thread relief grooves prevent interference at shoulder transitions
Groove angle typically 30° for grinding reliefs
Eventual specific grooves must be indicated in detail on drawing
Relief groove geometry standardized by size ranges to simplify manufacturing
training_guidance: NX agent should automatically create relief grooves at grinding zone boundaries based on shaft diameter range
For threads ending at shoulders with ledge function, insert thread relief groove per pitch specifications
Select groove dimensions (width, depth, radius) from table based on diameter (grinding) or thread pitch
Apply specified tolerances to groove width, depth, and axial position
Default to 30° groove angle for grinding relief applications
Flag non-standard groove requirements for explicit drawing detail callout
Validate that relief groove provides adequate clearance for grinding wheel or thread cutting tool exit
Use UNI4386 standard as baseline comparison for groove geometry verification
summary: This page defines standard relief groove geometry for both grinding zones (TAB-001) and threaded areas (TAB-002). Grinding relief grooves are specified in four diameter ranges (18-50mm, 51-80mm, 81-125mm, >125mm) with corresponding widths, depths, radii, and tolerances compared against UNI4386 standard. Thread relief grooves are dimensioned based on thread pitch (P<1.25, 1.5-2, 2.5-3) and must be used when threads terminate at shoulders. All non-standard grooves require explicit drawing callouts.
